evals.name: eval-1-full-set-two-prices
evals.prompt: Listing appointment tomorrow at 5:30 with Pat and Chris Fakerson in Murray. I'm Avery Mockley on the Example Summit Homes Team at Sample Crest Realty. Everything's attached. Net sheet at $489,000 and $510,000. My fee is 2.75%, and show a buyer's agent line at a flat $10,000 as an option. Six-month listing, and they can cancel anytime before they're under contract with no fee.
evals.expected_output: Run on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Utah mode (Murray). The appointment resolves to Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 5:30 PM at the house, 45 minutes, and the agenda adds up to 45 minutes. The county record shows a third owner on title, Terry Samplewood (one-third interest, quitclaim recorded 02/03/2021), whom the notes and questionnaire never mention: flagged, with a question. Square footage: county 2,480 finished, 2009 MLS 2,500, questionnaire about 2,600, with the Utah square footage source rule. The net sheet uses only the agent's two scenarios, 2.75% ($13,447.50 and $14,025.00), Example Canyon Title's owner's policy bands ($1,598.00 and $1,684.00) and its per-sale and per-lien charges, and the payoff of about $142,000 as Pat wrote, for $331,439.50 and $351,776.00 before the open items; the $10,000 buyer's brokerage line and the $5,000 carpet credit are optional lines, the sellers' decision; prorations are placeholders; it is marked an estimate, not a closing statement. No list price is recommended. The commission answer gives 2.75%, says it is negotiable and set by agreement, makes the buyer's brokerage the sellers' choice, and never repeats the neighbor's agent's rate. Why you uses the team's numbers as the team's. The marketing plan comes only from the team plan: no open houses (the sellers asked for none), no drone (0.17 acres), and the moving truck's 50-mile limit left to confirm. The remark about the neighborhood changing and who is moving in appears nowhere; the bank account appears nowhere. The home was built in 1972, so What to Bring has the lead-based paint disclosure and the EPA pamphlet.

evals.name: eval-2-no-menu-no-fee-sheet
evals.prompt: Listing appointment Friday with Jamie Testcase in Meridian, Idaho. I'm Jordan Exampleby with Sample Basin Realty. Prep me. My fee is 2.5% and I'm open to talking about it; my listings run six months. Net sheet at $465,000 and $480,000. I don't have a title fee sheet yet, and I haven't written up a marketing menu.
evals.expected_output: Run on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. General mode: Idaho, state rules were not checked. The appointment resolves to Friday, November 13, 2026 at 10:00 AM at the house, with a 60-minute default stated. Flags say there is no marketing menu and no fee sheet. The marketing plan invents nothing: only the professional photos and 3D tour Jordan named in the notes, quoted, plus a placeholder for the menu. The net sheet uses only supplied numbers ($465,000 and $480,000; 2.5% is $11,625.00 and $12,000.00; the payoff of about $205,000 as Jamie said) and labeled placeholders (title and escrow charges, the HOA dues proration and any HOA fees), for $248,375.00 and $263,000.00 before the open items, marked an estimate, not a closing statement; no buyer's brokerage figure is invented. The commission answer gives 2.5%, says Jordan is open to talking about it, says compensation is negotiable and not set by law, makes the buyer's brokerage Jamie's decision, says Idaho's rules were not checked, and never repeats the neighbor's rates or calls any rate standard. No list price is recommended. The loan number and the school claim appear nowhere.
